Description: Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) protocols have to answer the limited capacities of sensor nodes. Routing protocols generate a considerable amount of traffic when nodes are mobile and thus contribute to the energy consumption and to the overloading of the medium with control traffic. The ZigBee standard proposes a lightweight hierarchical routing protocol that does not cope well with mobility as shown in the literature. In this paper, we extend a novel opportunistic approach based on the ZigBee standard to which we added functionalities that handles mobility in WSN. Critical periodical information transmitted by mobile nodes is routed through a fixed multi-hop tree topology towards a sink connected to a control station. We evaluate the protocol using the NS-2 simulator.

Description: Wireless technologies offer many advantages in communication between Internet of Things (IoT) devices, yet, it lacks in performance especially indoors where walls, metal, and other objects deteriorate their performance. LoRa is a new technology that may offer better indoor performance. In this article, we present and analyze LoRa's parameters, and aim to optimize them for use in a reinforced concrete building. Our experimental results show that increasing the spreading factor (SF) and coding rate (CR) increase the packet transmission duration, which has a detrimental effect on the packet reception ratio. Moreover, our main contribution is that we propose an optimized configuration that results in a higher packet reception ratio in an indoor environment.
